subject.title: fix(cron): allow timeoutSeconds: 0 for no-timeout mode

question: Should the Control UI expose the existing cron `timeoutSeconds: 0` no-timeout contract to users?
rationale: The backend and protocol already accept zero, but the UI currently blocks it and exposing no-timeout jobs has availability implications that a maintainer should accept deliberately.

options.title: Accept no-timeout in UI after refresh
options.body: Land a refreshed fix that preserves explicit zero, rejects malformed values, and includes regression coverage plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep UI positive-only
options.body: Close this PR and the canonical UI issue if no-timeout should remain unavailable through the Control UI despite the gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Accept no-timeout in UI after refresh
recommendation.body: Land a refreshed fix that preserves explicit zero, rejects malformed values, and includes regression coverage plus real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman authored and merged the cron edit parity PR that introduced the relevant UI behavior.
